# Frog

> Frog (formerly "SBL") is a training lab notebook: users log workouts (exercises, sets of
> weight×reps, RIR, notes) AND the conditions around them (sleep, bodyweight,
> pre-workout carbs, caffeine, stress, meal timing), then the app surfaces
> correlations between inputs and outputs ("Findings"). All user data is
> open: JSON/CSV export, a personal-access-token read API, and an MCP server.

## Auth

Every API request needs a personal access token (created in-app under
Settings → API tokens): `Authorization: Bearer frog_...`. Tokens are
read-only and scoped to the owning user's data.

## REST API (read-only)

Base: `<SUPABASE_PROJECT_URL>/functions/v1/api`

- `GET /v1/exercises?limit&offset` — exercises (global seeds + community-shared + user's custom; `created_by` names the publisher of shared rows)
- `GET /v1/sessions?limit&offset` — sessions, newest first, incl. `condition_values` ({metric_id: value})
- `GET /v1/sets?limit&offset` — flat set logs (set_no, side, weight_kg, reps, rir, rir_min, rir_max, note, metric_values). A unilateral set is two rows sharing one set_no, distinguished by side ('left'|'right'|null).
- `GET /v1/export` — everything: exercises, metrics, sessions, session_exercises, set_logs

Example:

    curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $FROG_TOKEN" \
      "$FROG_API_URL/v1/sessions?limit=10"

## Data model (stable)

Tables: exercises, metrics, sessions, session_exercises, set_logs.
Conventions: uuid ids; created_at/updated_at/deleted_at are millisecond
epochs; rows are soft-deleted (deleted_at set, never removed); weight is
canonical kg (weight_kg); custom values live in jsonb keyed by metric id
(sessions.condition_values, set_logs.metric_values); metrics have
type (number|scale|text|checkbox) and scope (set|session).

Full schema reference: docs/schema.md in the repo. API reference: docs/api.md.

## MCP server

TypeScript stdio server (`frog-mcp`, packages/mcp in the repo). Config env:
FROG_TOKEN (required), FROG_API_URL. Tools: list_exercises, list_sessions,
get_session, get_sets, get_progression (runs the findings engine locally),
export_all.
